:::{#sol-expected-density-normal}

The [density](random-variables.qmd#def-pdf) is $\p(X=x) = \frac{1}{\sqrt{2\pi\ss}}\exp\paren{-\frac{(x-\mean)^2}{2\ss}}$:

$$
\ba
\E{\p(X=X)}
&= \int_{-\infty}^{\infty} \frac{1}{2\pi\ss}\exp\paren{-\frac{(x-\mean)^2}{\ss}}\,dx
&& \text{(integral of the squared density; square the density)}
\\&= \frac{1}{2\pi\ss} \int_{-\infty}^{\infty} e^{-u^2}\,\sigma\,du
&& \text{(substitute } u = (x-\mean)/\sigma \text{, so } dx = \sigma\,du \text{)}
\\&= \frac{\sigma\sqrt{\pi}}{2\pi\ss}
&& \text{(the given integral)}
\\&= \frac{1}{2\sigma\sqrt{\pi}}.
&& \text{(simplify)}
\ea
$$

A larger [standard deviation](#def-sd) $\sigma$ spreads the density out and lowers its [expected value](#def-expectation).

:::
